This is about stopping waste before it starts. Better information, smarter decisions, and less unnecessary spending. We don’t need more government. We need better government.

Before Congress votes on new laws, this bill requires a duplication check. The GAO will flag whether legislation creates overlapping programs or agencies so lawmakers know exactly what they’re funding.

Washington is running thousands of duplicative programs that do the same thing and cost taxpayers billions. The Duplication Scoring Act is about one simple principle: stop paying twice for the same government.
